name: acoustic
note: Struck string. B = 4e-4 at A4, stretched to 8.6e-5 at F1 and 8.6e-4 at F6 across the piece's range. tau_1 = 2.4 s at A4, halving every two octaves up. Rolloff and decay exponent were set by sweeping them against the spectral centroid of single notes at F2/F3/F4/F5 and picking the pair that lands the centroid near 3x the fundamental, which is where measured piano tones sit. The tine fields are zeroed, not omitted: the schema is shared and every key is always present.
